Prince William Launches Regeneration Fund for Dartmoor Village

Prince William is set to launch a new regeneration fund aimed at supporting an isolated village near Dartmoor prison. The initiative seeks to address the specific needs of the community. The fund's creation was announced by The Independent and the Evening Standard.
